name: Systolic blood pressure
measured_on_board: Bio-Monitor smart shirt or arm cuff

name: Diastolic blood pressure
measured_on_board: Bio-Monitor smart shirt or arm cuff

name: Sleep duration
measured_on_board: Actiwatch wrist monitor and daily questionnaire

name: Blood glucose
measured_on_board: i-STAT blood analyser, fingerstick sample, not continuous

name: Reaction time median
measured_on_board: 90-second reaction test adapted from the 3-minute PVT-B (ISS Reaction Self Test); median of valid trials; stimulus after a random 2 to 5 s wait

name: Reaction lapses
measured_on_board: 90-second reaction test adapted from the 3-minute PVT-B (ISS Reaction Self Test); a trial of 355 ms or more counts as a lapse

name: Appetite
measured_on_board: Self-rated question at the daily check-in, once a day

name: Fluid intake
measured_on_board: Metered galley dispenser; the crew logs the water drunk and the water used to rehydrate food

name: Body mass
measured_on_board: SLAMMD; mass from F = ma, and the Russian BMMD in the ISS programme
